strategies.statement: Deliver solutions as thin vertical MVPs — prove value end-to-end before scaling
strategies.driver: Big-bang programmes overshoot timeline and budget while under-delivering on outcome
strategies.target-outcome: Initiatives over GBP 500k deliver a measurable customer outcome within 90 days of kick-off

strategies.statement: Reuse before bespoke — solution patterns are the first port of call for every new initiative
strategies.driver: Bespoke solutions multiply maintenance load and architectural drift; reuse compounds investment
strategies.target-outcome: A documented solution-pattern catalogue covering the top 10 solution archetypes; reuse evidenced in every architecture review

strategies.statement: Production-ready from day one — operations, observability, and security are part of the MVP, not a follow-up
strategies.driver: Production-readiness debt accumulated during build is dramatically more expensive to retire afterwards
strategies.target-outcome: No initiative passes its first release gate without operability sign-off

strategies.statement: Total cost of ownership — solution investment cases include operations and exit, not just build
strategies.driver: Build-only TCO understates lifecycle cost and biases towards over-building
strategies.target-outcome: Every approved investment case includes 5-year operate-and-exit costs reviewed by Finance and Architecture jointly

strategies.statement: Build for change — every solution assumes its constraints will evolve, including a credible exit path
strategies.driver: Solutions designed for permanence become irreversible when constraints shift
strategies.target-outcome: Every solution design includes a documented evolution and exit plan
